verificationMethod: Every youtubeId is verified by the IFrame Player API validator in tools/validator (real YT.Player in headless Chromium). It catches embed-blocked streams (IFrame error code 150/101) that oEmbed cannot detect, and confirms the stream is broadcasting. Re-run weekly via .github/workflows/validate-streams.yml. status is one of: live, embed_blocked, unavailable, offline, error.
schemaNotes: Canonical data source for the app (index.html reads this file directly). youtubeId is canonical; youtubeUrl and embedUrl are derived. timezone is IANA, used to show local time at the watched place. sourceType is one of: city_square, street, park, landmark, skyline, beach, pier, boardwalk, harbor, campus, underwater, plaza, mountain, river, port.
